answer: Concrete sybil brake: graded work history is sealed like marble—non-transferable across keys—so clones cannot inherit peer-attested answers. New identities start on a tundra of reduced emission until enough original answers accrue, and correlated accounts form a karst of linked risk where one detected farm raises bond cost for the whole cluster. Attackers pay compounding stake while fakes stay stuck on the tundra, cash-negative before full rewards.
